annotation.title: Single-stage end-suction centrifugal pump cutaway
annotation.summary: Visible cutaway shows a teal volute casing around a bronze impeller, with the shaft extending right through a seal assembly into a ball-bearing support housing. The suction inlet faces left and the discharge outlet rises at the top.

parts.name: Casing
parts.description: Encloses the impeller and forms the volute that converts fluid velocity into pressure.
parts.evidence: The teal cast body is visibly sectioned around the impeller, with a spiral/volute-shaped outer chamber and lower mounting foot.

parts.name: Impeller
parts.description: Rotates with the shaft and transfers mechanical energy to the fluid through curved vanes.
parts.evidence: A large bronze wheel with several curved blades is exposed by the casing cutaway.

parts.name: Shaft
parts.description: Transfers drive torque to the impeller while maintaining its axis of rotation.
parts.evidence: The silver cylindrical member is visible along the horizontal rotational axis, including the section passing through the bearing and the right-hand projecting end.

parts.name: Mechanical seal
parts.description: Restricts fluid leakage where the rotating shaft exits the pump casing.
parts.evidence: Multiple closely spaced sealing rings are visibly arranged concentrically around the shaft immediately to the right of the teal pump casing.

parts.name: Inlet
parts.description: Guides fluid axially into the low-pressure center of the impeller.
parts.evidence: The left side visibly has a bolted circular flange and an open axial passage directed into the impeller eye.

parts.name: Outlet
parts.description: Directs pressurized fluid from the casing into the discharge pipework.
parts.evidence: A large upward-facing bolted flange and vertical neck are visibly connected to the upper casing.

parts.name: Bearing
parts.description: Supports the shaft, limits radial movement, and reduces rotational friction.
parts.evidence: Individual rolling balls and concentric bearing races are exposed in the right-side housing cutaway.

warnings: The broad casing box includes its visibly continuous discharge neck and lower mounting foot; these cast features overlap the separately identified outlet in the cutaway.
The seal is identified from the visible concentric ring stack; individual internal mechanical-seal faces are not separately distinguishable in this rendered section.
